topics.title: Reported Speech
topics.explanation: When we report what someone said, we usually shift the tense back one step (present becomes past, etc.).
topics.explanationAr: عندما ننقل ما قاله شخص ما، نحول الزمن عادة خطوة للخلف (المضارع يصبح ماضيا، إلخ).

examples.en: "I am tired," she said. -> She said she was tired.
examples.ar: "أنا متعبة"، قالت. -> قالت إنها كانت متعبة.

examples.en: "I will help," he said. -> He said he would help.
"We like pizza," they said. -> They said they liked pizza.
examples.ar: "نحب البيتزا"، قالوا. -> قالوا إنهم يحبون البيتزا.

examples.en: "I have finished," she said. -> She said she had finished.

topics.title: Relative Clauses (who, which, that)
topics.explanation: Who, which, and that connect extra information to a noun. "Who" is for people, "which" for things, "that" for either.
topics.explanationAr: who وwhich وthat تربط معلومة إضافية باسم. "who" للأشخاص، و"which" للأشياء، و"that" للاثنين.

examples.en: The girl who lives next door is my friend.
The book which I read was great.
This is the dog that barks a lot.
examples.ar: هذا هو الكلب الذي ينبح كثيرا.

examples.en: I know the boy who won the race.

topics.title: Third Conditional
topics.explanation: "If + past perfect, would have + past participle" describes an unreal past situation and its imagined (but impossible now) result.
topics.explanationAr: "If + ماضٍ تام، would have + التصريف الثالث" تصف موقفا ماضيا غير حقيقي ونتيجته المتخيلة (المستحيلة الآن).

examples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
She would have called if she had known.
If they had left earlier, they wouldn't have missed the bus.
examples.ar: لو غادروا مبكرا، لما فاتتهم الحافلة.

topics.title: Reported Questions
topics.explanation: When reporting a question, the word order changes to a statement, and we don't use a question mark.
topics.explanationAr: عند نقل سؤال، يتغير ترتيب الكلمات إلى جملة خبرية، ولا نستخدم علامة استفهام.

examples.en: "Where do you live?" -> She asked where I lived.
"Are you happy?" -> He asked if I was happy.
examples.ar: "هل أنت سعيد؟" -> سأل إن كنت سعيدا.

examples.en: "What is your name?" -> They asked what my name was.
"Can you help?" -> She asked if I could help.
examples.ar: "هل يمكنك المساعدة؟" -> سألت إن كان بإمكاني المساعدة.

topics.title: Common Phrasal Verbs
topics.explanation: A phrasal verb is a verb + preposition/particle whose meaning is often different from the individual words.
topics.explanationAr: الفعل المركب هو فعل + حرف جر/أداة، ومعناه غالبا مختلف عن معنى الكلمات منفردة.

examples.en: Please turn off the light.
I need to look after my sister.
Can you give up sugar?
They set up a new club.

topics.title: Wish / If Only
topics.explanation: We use "wish" or "if only" + past simple to talk about something we want to be different now.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "wish" أو "if only" + ماضٍ بسيط للحديث عن شيء نريده مختلفا الآن.

examples.en: I wish I had a pet.
examples.ar: أتمنى لو كان لدي حيوان أليف.

examples.en: If only I knew the answer.
She wishes she could fly.
I wish it wasn't raining.

topics.title: Past Perfect
topics.explanation: "Had + past participle" describes an action that happened before another action in the past.
topics.explanationAr: "had + التصريف الثالث" تصف فعلا حدث قبل فعل آخر في الماضي.

examples.en: I had finished my homework before dinner.
examples.ar: كنت قد أنهيت واجبي قبل العشاء.

examples.en: She had left when I arrived.
We had never seen snow before that trip.
examples.ar: لم نكن قد رأينا الثلج قبل تلك الرحلة.

examples.en: Had you eaten before the movie?
examples.ar: هل كنت قد أكلت قبل الفيلم؟

topics.title: Linking Words (although, however, despite)
topics.explanation: Words like although, however, and despite connect contrasting ideas in a sentence or between sentences.
topics.explanationAr: كلمات مثل although وhowever وdespite تربط أفكارا متناقضة داخل جملة أو بين جمل.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we played outside.
examples.ar: على الرغم من أنها كانت تمطر، لعبنا في الخارج.

examples.en: I was tired. However, I finished my homework.
examples.ar: كنت متعبا. ومع ذلك، أنهيت واجبي.

examples.en: Despite the cold, she went swimming.
He is young; however, he is very smart.
examples.ar: هو صغير؛ ومع ذلك، فهو ذكي جدا.
